name: How do minor framing adjustments actually work once a contractor opens the wall?

mainEntity.name: How do minor framing adjustments actually work once a contractor opens the wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with measuring the affected area, identifying the cause, and checking surrounding framing for hidden damage. After that, the crew may shim, re-square, sister, reinforce, replace short sections, or adjust openings so the finished surface can install correctly. Good documentation matters because a small framing change can affect drywall, trim, doors, cabinets, or siding later.
acceptedAnswer.description: It starts with measuring and diagnosis, then the crew corrects the framing by shimming, re-squaring, sistering, or reinforcing the affected area. The goal is to restore alignment without creating problems for drywall, trim, doors, or other finishes.
